profiles.field_rule: Research trial: look for an unbranched cereal spike with alternating sessile spikelets, an inner membranous ligule and (when visible) leaf auricles. Wheat cultivars and other cereal grasses overlap; lemma awns and tufting are deliberately left unknown. Never infer a wild Hays population from crop imagery.
